verdict.rationale: Kick publishes a documented llms.txt index (confirmed live via probe returning HTTP 200) plus markdown mirrors of every doc page and a dynamic 'ask' query endpoint, explicitly built for agent legibility via GitBook. This directly satisfies pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of agents successfully using the llms.txt index in practice, and clarity on how complete/current the llms.txt index is relative to the full doc set.
